title: On the unmapped tent pitching for the heterogeneous wave equation
summary: The Unmapped Tent Pitching (UTP) algorithm is a space--time domain decomposition method for the parallel solution of hyperbolic problems. It was originally introduced for the homogeneous one-dimensional wave equation in [Ciaramella, Gander, Mazzieri, 2024]. UTP is inspired by the Mapped Tent Pitching (MTP) algorithm [Gopalakrishnan, Sch{ö}berl, Wintersteiger, 2017], which constructs the solution by iteratively building polytopal space--time subdomains, referred to as tents.
